narrationTexts: I'll look at the project first.
finalText:
Build green, exit 0. Two real bugs, both from bump — not noise:

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — bundler renamed options key `retries` to `retryCount`. Old read threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`, throws clear `TypeError` if neither is number.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old returned `false`. Strict check threw. Now `undefined` maps to `false` — matches old default (backoff disabled). Non-boolean junk still throws.

Rest is noise: 8 warnings left are deprecation notices (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`, unused-export, circular-import). Build counts them but they don't fail it.

Worth queuing separately, not blocking:
- `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` — removed in v5, and it derives keys with no IV. Real security debt.
- circular import `src/core/graph.js <-> src/state/tracker.js` — "resolution order is undefined" bites later.

Those files aren't in this tree, so I left them alone.
